subject: Portal activation, PO prefix and MSA redlines for BlueStone
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluestone-tx.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@bluestone-tx.com
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood onboarding — Ariba registration link and MSA questions

Hi Olga / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward but have two parallel items our procurement team needs help with before we can issue a PO: portal activation (Ariba enrollment) and the contract redlines. 

Quick summary of what we need:
- Ariba supplier registration completed and the required portal fields that BlueStone must provide (we have a few custom GL/Cost Center fields).
- Confirmation on the PO numbering schema you can accept (our PO prefix is BST- and we need to ensure Redwood's PO parser ingests that without dropping the prefix).
- We received an initial MSA from legal and attached it for your review — there are several redlines around data retention and audit access.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the Ariba field mapping, and whether you can accept BST- prefixed POs? Also attaching the MSA we were sent. If possible, please review and call out the non-starters so we can move to a clean execution.

Appreciate it — aiming to have this closed in the next two weeks.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Sr. Vendor Manager | BlueStone Therapeutics
elena.morales@bluestone-tx.com
(512) 555-0182

Attachments: BlueStone_MSA_initial_redlines.pdf (PDF, 412 KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluestone-tx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — Ariba registration link and MSA questions

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Vivek (ops) and Marissa (legal coordination).

Short answers up front:
- PO prefix: yes, we can ingest BST- prefixed purchase orders. We will confirm with finance the accepted character set by tomorrow and provide a PO sample back to you.
- Ariba: we have a standard field mapping for Ariba registration but BlueStone has a custom "Cost Allocation" field — can you share the exact column name and valid values? I attached a short mapping template for you to complete.
- MSA redlines: thank you for the PDF. I converted the redlines into our internal redline doc and included commentary. There are three areas that require legal-led decisions: data retention (section 5.2), audit access (section 9), and indemnity caps. Our position summary is in the attached DOCX.

Open items for you to confirm:
1) Cost Allocation values (so we can populate Ariba).
2) Whether BlueStone requires record-level deletion on demand (our standard is retention for 30 days for production logs, longer for billing logs).
3) Any SOX/regulated-substance clauses that need specific handling in the portal (I've seen this from other pharma customers).

Proposed next steps:
- You populate the Ariba field mapping template and return it by EOD Wed 17 Mar.
- Our legal (Marissa) will provide an MSA response matrix by Thu 18 Mar with redline accept/decline and suggested language.
- Once mapping is accepted, Vivek will kick off portal provisioning and provide a test PO for ingestion.

I've attached: 1) Redwood_MSA_BlueStone_redline_20270314.docx (our annotated redline), 2) BlueStone_Ariba_Field_Mapping.xlsx (template).

If you want to skip email, happy to set a 30-minute call tomorrow morning to walk through the mapping.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Partner Onboarding | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_BlueStone_redline_20270314.docx (DOCX, 95 KB); BlueStone_Ariba_Field_Mapping.xlsx (XLSX, 22 KB)

From: Jason Li <jason.li@bluestone-tx.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bluestone-tx.com>, procurement@bluestone-tx.com
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — Ariba registration link and MSA questions

Olga — attaching the completed mapping and a short note on the PO prefix.

Answers:
- Cost Allocation field name: "BS_COST_ALLOC" with allowed values: R&D, COMM, CLINICAL, G&A.
- Yes, BST- prefix is required for our internal ERP routing; sample PO attached (PO_Sample_12345.pdf).
- On record deletion: per our legal, we need the ability to request deletion of non-billing logs within 7 business days. Billing records must be retained for 7 years.

We uploaded the supplier registration to Ariba and the registration id is 98765. Please confirm your side has visibility so we can test a PO ingestion.

Thanks — Jason
IT Procurement | BlueStone Therapeutics

Attachments: BlueStone_Ariba_Field_Mapping_completed.xlsx (XLSX, 18 KB); PO_Sample_12345.pdf (PDF, 130 KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Mar 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood onboarding — Ariba registration link and MSA questions

Jason / Elena — following up from our internal review. Summary of our positions and next steps below.

Legal summary (high level):
- Section 5.2 (Data retention): We can accept a hybrid approach. Redwood agrees to delete non-billing logs within 10 business days (we can push to 7 as a commercial concession if this is a blocker). Billing records retained 7 years — redline accepted with standard audit trails retained for billing.
- Section 9 (Audit access): We will provide reasonable audit access via a scoped attestation and redact internal tooling data. We cannot agree to unfettered live access; propose a quarterly audit or on-demand with 15 business days' notice.
- Indemnity and caps: We proposed a mutual cap tied to the prior 12 months' fees; BlueStone legal to confirm if that is acceptable.

Operational items:
- Vivek confirmed Ariba registration ID 98765 is visible on our side and provisioning for test account is queued. He will post the test endpoint and sample PO ingestion log by EOD Wed 24 Mar.
- PO prefix: Finance has vetted BST- and confirmed our parser will preserve alphanumeric prefixes. We will return a sample ingestion log.

Requested confirmations from BlueStone:
1) Are you willing to accept Redwood's proposed 10 business-day deletion window, or do you need 7?
2) Confirm acceptance of scoped audit (quarterly or on-demand with notice).
3) Does BlueStone accept the mutual cap draft (Marissa can share language if needed).

If those are OK, we can move to DocuSign and schedule go-live for portal ingestion and first PO in the week of 29 Mar.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
